name: Tailgrids
summary: 100+ free MIT React + Tailwind components via Tailgrids CLI; freemium Pro blocks.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free core comps from 100+; Pro blocks/templates excluded.

Docs import paths vary slightly by component (e.g. accordion anatomy uses `@/components/accordion`; badge usage shows `@/components/badge`; most others use `@/components/tailgrids/core/{slug}`). CLI resolves install paths.
